$comment: What a burst explorer can hand a gated population to.
ChiSurf advertises this list over `bursts.consumers`; ndXplorer (or any
other explorer) discovers it and builds its 'Send selection to' menu from
what it is told. The explorer therefore knows no ChiSurf method names, and
adding an analysis is a row here plus a service - no change on the client.
Plugins extend the list by declaring a `burst_consumers` array in their
manifest.json with the same field names.
key             stable identifier the client sends back to dispatch
summary         one line on what comes back (menu tooltip)
rpc             the method that does the work
per_file        true  -> one call per file, with tttr_path + ranges
false -> one call carrying the whole burst_slices mapping
operation_type  mmCIF operation vocabulary term for the provenance record
product_type    mmCIF artifact vocabulary term for what it produces
defaults        parameters sent when the caller supplies none
caveat          shown to the user before the result is trusted; omit when
the analysis means what it appears to mean

consumers.title: FCS
consumers.summary: Correlate the gated bursts; returns correlation curves per file.

consumers.title: TCSPC decay
consumers.summary: Micro-time decay of the gated photons, one per detector group.

consumers.title: PDA
consumers.summary: Experimental S1/S2 photon-distribution histogram, ready to fit.

consumers.title: PCH
consumers.summary: Photon-counting histogram P(k) over the gated span.
consumers.caveat: P(k) from bursts only means brightness in 'span' mode, which keeps the inter-burst background. In 'interior' mode the low-k side is truncated: comparable between gated populations, not an absolute brightness.
